race.comment: TUFFLEE (10) gets the nod on debut after a close second in his latest Cranbourne trial and the inside barrier gives him a clean starting point for the Begg/Childs combination which is always potent. The race lacks a dominant exposed maiden and this looks a nice option. SUPERWILL (9) has the best recent race evidence, having finished third at this track first-up, beaten a long neck, and the 2kg claim helps him build on that second-up. GALLANTRY (4) resumes after taking on better company at Flemington and Sandown-Lakeside last preparation, with his fourth at Sandown-Lakeside beaten just over a length the run that measures up strongly here. LOYALTY (12) was okay on debut at Ballarat when unsuited by the slow pace and could improve.
